digest.component_or_area: Rebar Janitor remediation and contributor workflows
propositions: Contributor and agent guidance must use each contributor's real DCO identity, with Joe Oakhart's bot identity appearing only in explicitly automated workflows
Force flag bypasses all gates including future gates, but ticket-system invariants like the open-children close prohibition remain non-bypassable
LLM verification must preserve flexible provider-independent parsing and self-healing while rejecting semantically empty outcomes as invalid review results
Plan review cannot pass cleanly when ticket hierarchy is loaded incompletely unless the omitted context is demonstrably irrelevant
ChatGPT-specific guidance must document safe Rebar usage when GitHub repository is a read-only mirror and native clone, Gerrit, or tracker access is unavailable
